from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from downloads import resolve_download

with TemporaryDirectory(dir='.') as tmp:
    base = Path(tmp).resolve()
    root = base / 'downloads'
    root.mkdir()
    sibling = base / 'downloads-extra'
    sibling.mkdir()
    (root / 'sub').mkdir()
    (root / 'file').write_bytes(b'inside data')
    (sibling / 'file').write_bytes(b'outside data')
    (root / 'inside').symlink_to(root / 'sub', target_is_directory=True)
    (root / 'outside').symlink_to(sibling, target_is_directory=True)
    def snapshot():
        result = {}
        for p in base.rglob('*'):
            key = str(p.relative_to(base))
            if p.is_symlink():
                result[key] = ('symlink', str(p.readlink()))
            elif p.is_dir():
                result[key] = ('directory',)
            else:
                result[key] = ('file', p.read_bytes())
        return result
    before = snapshot()
    for name, expected in [('', root), ('.', root), ('file', root / 'file'),
                           ('sub/../file', root / 'file'),
                           ('missing/child', root / 'missing/child'),
                           ('inside/new', root / 'sub/new')]:
        actual = resolve_download(root, name)
        assert isinstance(actual, Path)
        assert actual == expected, (name, actual, expected)
    for name in [str(root / 'file'), str(root), '/', '../downloads-extra/file',
                 '../elsewhere', 'sub/../../downloads-extra/file', 'outside/file',
                 'outside/missing']:
        try:
            resolve_download(root, name)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f'accepted forbidden name: {name}')
    assert snapshot() == before, 'filesystem contents changed'
print('Passed: 6 accepted paths, 8 rejected paths, unchanged filesystem snapshot.')
